title: A missing event, help or topic page says "index, follow", and a few member pages answer 200 to a crawler

source.ref: SEO, GEO and speed deep scan 2026-11-19 (production crawl of 3,000 URLs, all 720 sitemap pages, 8 crawler user agents, Lighthouse on 14 templates)

detail:
The not-found page for an event, a help article and a topic answers 404 but its robots meta says index, follow (harmless to Google, confusing to simpler crawlers). /feed answers 200 and indexable to a signed-out request (robots keeps crawlers out, the page itself does not say noindex). /events/calendar is indexable and not in the sitemap. 686 /sign-in?next=... addresses were crawled; they are noindex and left crawlable on purpose. The site has no web app manifest and no security.txt (the apple-touch-icon is linked from /icons/ and works).

A missing event, help article or topic now returns missingPageMetadata (lib/seo/not-found-metadata.ts): noindex, follow on the 404, whichever way Next resolves the error path. /feed and /events/calendar say noindex, follow (the calendar is the same events /events lists). /.well-known/security.txt names hello@frequencylocal.com with an Expires renewed on every build. The web app manifest was already live at /manifest.json, linked from the root layout; the crawl had asked for /manifest.webmanifest.

verify.note: Fails on main: a missing event, help article or topic resolves to the root's index, follow; /feed and /events/calendar say nothing; no security.txt. Passes once each says noindex, follow and /.well-known/security.txt names a contact.
